script.title: CALLING THE PLUMBER
script.story_hook: A cup of water overnight, and one brave phone call.
script.intro_zh: 一晚能裝一杯水的漏水，和一通勇敢的求助電話。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's phone call at the plumbing office. Listen for booking words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎收聽今天這通水電行電話。留意預約相關的說法。
script.outro: Booked, warned, and ready for Thursday. Listen twice and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 預約完成、注意事項聽好、週四就緒。聽兩遍再逐句跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's echo this whole phone call together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀這通電話。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful woman in her mid thirties with dark shoulder-length hair in a loose braid, a mustard yellow cardigan over a plain white tee, small round earrings, an average build
script.char_b_description: a calm man in his forties with close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, rimless glasses, a navy polo shirt with a plumbing company logo on the pocket, broad shoulders, a solid build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I think I need a plumber today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ θɪŋk aɪ nid ə ˈplʌmɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想我今天需要一位水電師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're at Riverside Plumbing, how can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz æt ˈɹɪvɚsaɪd ˈplʌmɪŋ haʊ kən aɪ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 這裡是河濱水電行，請問有什麼可以幫您？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a leak under my kitchen sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə lik ˈʌndɚ maɪ ˈkɪtʃɪn sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我家廚房水槽底下在漏水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, is it dripping fast or slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ɪt ˈdɹɪpɪŋ fæst ɔɹ sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，水滴得快還是慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast enough to fill a cup overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst ɪˈnʌf tə fɪl ə kʌp ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 快到來一晚就能滴滿一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Any water on the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛni ˈwɔɾɚ ɑn ðə flɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。地板上有水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a wet spot inside the cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə wɛt spɑt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈkæbənɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只有櫥櫃裡面濕了一小塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the cabinet door swollen at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkæbənɪt dɔɹ ˈswoʊlən ət ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 櫥櫃的門有沒有膨脹變形？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little, um, the wood looks wavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl ʌm ðə wʊd lʊks ˈweɪvi/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，嗯，木頭都泡得波浪狀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That tells us it's been leaking a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tɛlz ʌs ɪts bɪn ˈlikɪŋ ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這代表它已經漏了一陣子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, my favorite kind of news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt kaɪnd əv nuz/
dialogue.zh: 真棒，我最愛這種消息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll fix it quick. What's your address?
dialogue.phonetic: /wil fɪks ɪt kwɪk wʌts jɔɹ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 我們會快點修好。您的地址是哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four two one, Maple Street, unit B.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ tu wʌn ˈmeɪpəl stɹit ˈjunɪt bi/
dialogue.zh: 楓葉街四二一號，B 單元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maple B... I have you on file from last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪpəl bi aɪ hæv ju ɑn faɪl fɹʌm læst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 楓葉街 B……我們有您去年的紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh really? Yes, the toilet flapper thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈɹɪli jɛs ðə ˈtɔɪlət ˈflæpɚ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢真的嗎？對，就是馬桶換小零件那次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. Returning customers get good news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn ɹɪˈtɝnɪŋ ˈkʌstəməz ɡɛt ɡʊd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 就是那次。老顧客有好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now that sentence interests me.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðæt ˈsɛntəns ˈɪnɾɚstɪz mi/
dialogue.zh: 這句話我可感興趣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The service call fee drops to sixty-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɝvɪs kɔl fi dɹɑps tə ˈsɪksti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 到府服務費降為六十九塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-nine? What's that for exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti naɪn wʌts ðæt fɔɹ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 六十九塊？這錢到底是付什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers the visit and the diagnosis.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌvɚz ðə ˈvɪzɪt ænd ðə ˌdaɪəɡˈnoʊsɪs/
dialogue.zh: 它涵蓋上門和檢查診斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if you need the actual repair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ju nid ði ˈæktʃuəl ɹɪˈpɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那如果需要真的動手修呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We quote parts and labor before touching anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi koʊt pɑɹts ænd ˈleɪbɚ bɪˈfɔɹ ˈtʌtʃɪŋ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 動手之前，我們會先報零件和工資。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No surprise invoices? I love that rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sɚˈpɹaɪz ˈɪnvɔɪsəz aɪ lʌv ðæt ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 不會有驚喜帳單？我愛這規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's policy, not charity, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈpɑləsi nɑt ˈtʃɑɹəti hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 這是制度，不是慈善，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take that as a yes. When is soonest?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ðæt æz ə jɛs wɛn ɪz ˈsunəst/
dialogue.zh: 那我就當您答應了。最快什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The earliest window is Thursday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɝliɪst ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 最早的時段是週四上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday mornings are hard, I have the kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɑɹ hɑɹd aɪ hæv ðə kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 週四上午很困難，我得照顧小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, one afternoon spot: one to three, Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wʌn ˈæftɚˌnun spɑt wʌn tə θɹi ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，還有一個下午時段：週四一點到三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works! Let's book the afternoon one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɝks lɛts bʊk ði ˌæftɚˈnun wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這個可以！就訂下午那個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second... oh, sorry, it just got taken.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd oʊ ˈsɑɹi ɪt dʒʌst ɡɑt ˈteɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 等一下……噢，抱歉，剛好讓人先訂走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taken? How? I literally heard you say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪkən haʊ aɪ ˈlɪɾɚli hɝd ju seɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 訂走了？怎會？我親耳聽你說過的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another call came in while we spoke. I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðɚ kɔl keɪm ɪn waɪl wi spoʊk aɪm ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 就在我們說話時，另一通電話也進來了，很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, okay. What else is open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ oʊˈkeɪ wʌt ɛls ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 唉，好吧。還有別的時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday three to six, or Friday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ θɹi tə sɪks ɔɹ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週四三點到六點，或是週五上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday mornings are out, school drop-off chaos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɑɹ aʊt skul ˈdɹɑpˌɔf ˈkeɪɑs/
dialogue.zh: 週五上午不行，送小孩上學一團亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, three to six on Thursday, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ θɹi tə sɪks ɑn ˈθɝzdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，就週四三點到六點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I'll take that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz aɪl teɪk ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對，麻煩您。我就選那個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked in, no one else gets it, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt ɪn noʊ wʌn ɛls ɡɛts ɪt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 鎖定了，誰也搶不走，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice save. Anything I should do before then?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs seɪv ˈɛnɪθɪŋ aɪ ʃʊd du bɪˈfɔɹ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這個時段救得漂亮。去之前我要先做什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two things: clear stuff out from under the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu θɪŋz klɪɹ stʌf aʊt fɹʌm ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 兩件事：先把水槽下方的東西清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done deal. What's the second thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dil wʌts ðə ˈsɛkənd θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這沒問題。第二件呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find your shut-off valve and turn it off.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd jɔɹ ʃʌt ˈɑf vælv ænd tɝn ɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 找到開關閥門，把它關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little handle under the sink, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪɾəl ˈhændəl ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是水槽下那個小把手，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it — righty-tighty, you know it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt ˈɹaɪti ˈtaɪti ju noʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就是它——右轉緊、左轉鬆，知道這句吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left, right... I'll test it tonight, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ɹaɪt aɪl tɛst ɪt təˈnaɪt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 左邊右邊……我今晚先試一下，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just turn it before Thursday, then call if stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɝn ɪt bɪˈfɔɹ ˈθɝzdeɪ ðɛn kɔl ɪf stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 週四前先轉好，卡住就打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My husband can be home too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈhʌzbənd kən bi hoʊm tu ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我先生也可以在家等，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, two adults is even better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ tu əˈdʌlts ɪz ˈivən ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，兩個大人在更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's the one who found the leak, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ði wʌn hu faʊnd ðə lik hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 他才是發現漏水的人，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He gets the credit. You'll get a text today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɡɛts ðə ˈkɹɛdɪt ju ɡɛt ə tɛkst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 功勞歸他。今天您會收到確認訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Oh, do we pay cash or card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt oʊ du wi peɪ kæʃ ɔɹ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。噢，我們是用現金還是卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tech carries a card reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɛk ˈkæɹiz ə kɑɹd ˈɹidɚ/
dialogue.zh: 師傅會帶刷卡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, we're old-school about cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ wɪɹ ˈold skul əˈbaʊt kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 幸好問了，我們是老派，習慣用現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a receipt by email right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul ɡɛt ə ɹiˈsit baɪ ˈimeɪl ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 收據也會立刻寄到您信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything's clear, honestly that felt easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiθɪŋz klɪɹ ˈɑnəstli ðæt fɛlt ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 全都搞清楚了，老實說比想像簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaks are scary on the phone, less scary Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /likz ɑɹ ˈskɛɹi ɑn ðə foʊn lɛs ˈskɛɹi ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 漏水在電話裡很可怕，週四就不怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well said. Thank you for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl sɛd θæŋk ju fɚ jɔɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 說得好。謝謝您的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job. Text us if it gets worse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə dʒɑb tɛkst ʌs ɪf ɪt ɡɛts wɝs/
dialogue.zh: 這是應該的。變嚴重就傳訊找我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Have a good one, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。祝您今天愉快，再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, good luck with the valve tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɡʊd lʌk wɪð ðə vælv təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再見，今晚轉閥門順利。

script.youtube_title: 【預約水電🔧】「最快什麼時候」一通水槽漏水的求助電話實錄📞✨🎧｜聽完就會自己約維修｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Scheduling a Plumber
script.youtube_title_en: "It's Policy, Not Charity" — Scheduling an Emergency Plumber Visit
script.youtube_description:
「一晚能裝滿一杯水」，水槽底下的漏水聽起來像世界末日，但打給水電行其實沒那麼難。這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，是一通完整的報修預約電話。

你會聽到：怎麼形容漏水速度與櫥櫃狀況（The wood looks wavy.）；到府服務費、診斷費、報價規則的問與答；時段剛好讓人搶走怎麼再約（What else is open?）；還有閥門、刷卡、確認訊息等全部細節。

整段都是 A2 初級短句，都是美式自然語感：ugh, ha, locked in, done deal。聽完你就會用：When is soonest?、What's that for exactly?、Anything I should do before then?、Have a good one。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，下次要約師傅上門就不卡關。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Fast enough to fill a cup overnight." A leak under the kitchen sink feels like the end of the world, but calling a plumber is simpler than you think. This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built from one complete service-call booking.

You will hear: describing leak speed and cabinet damage (The wood looks wavy.); asking how service fees, diagnosis, and repair quotes really work; rescuing a time slot that just got taken (What else is open?); plus valve instructions, card payment, and confirmation text details.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences with natural American fillers like ugh, ha, locked in, done deal. By the end you'll own phrases like When is soonest?, What's that for exactly?, and Anything I should do before then?

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and book your next repair call in English.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧水電預約英文｜形容漏水・服務費・改時段｜師傅上門前要做什麼｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
晚上回家發現水槽底下一直在滴水，一個晚上就能滴滿一杯，第一通求救電話該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家坐在廚房地板上，打完一整通報修電話：從形容漏水、問到府服務費，到時段讓人搶走後改約、清空櫥櫃、練習關閥門，一口氣聽完 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📞 開場求救：Hi, I think I need a plumber today.
💰 問收費：Sixty-nine? What's that for exactly?
😤 時段遭搶：Taken? How? I literally heard you say it.
🔧 事前準備：Find your shut-off valve and turn it off.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 ugh、ha、done deal、locked in 這種真實語感唸進直覺裡。🎧
